_comment: Tool names and descriptions modelled on real MCP servers, so that ranking tests judge the search on the kind of text it actually sees. Not a synthetic tool_000 directory: that measures cost, this measures judgement.

tools.name: brave_web_search
tools.description: Performs a web search using the Brave Search API, ideal for general queries, news, articles, and online content. Use this for broad information gathering, recent events, or when you need diverse web sources. Supports pagination, content filtering, and freshness controls. Maximum 20 results per request, with offset for pagination.

tools.name: brave_local_search
tools.description: Searches for local businesses and places using Brave's Local Search API. Best for queries related to physical locations, businesses, restaurants, services, etc. Returns detailed information including business names and addresses, ratings and review counts, phone numbers and opening hours. Use this when the query implies 'near me' or mentions specific locations. Automatically falls back to web search if no local results are found.

servers.name: docs
servers.title: docs-site
servers.description: Renders and publishes the internal documentation site

tools.name: render_page
tools.description: Render one documentation page to HTML. The page source is read from disk as a markdown file in the docs directory; front matter is parsed for the title, and relative links are rewritten so that a file can reference another file or directory by path. Code blocks are highlighted, and a git commit hash is embedded in the footer so that a published page can be traced back to the source. Use search_docs to find a page first when you only know a phrase from it, and publish_site when every page has been rendered and the whole site should be uploaded. Rendering never writes to the repository or opens an issue; it only reads.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Full-text search across every documentation page, returning the matching page paths and a snippet around each match.

tools.name: publish_site
tools.description: Upload the rendered site to the hosting bucket and invalidate the CDN cache.
